# Security policy

This project is in early alpha. Security fixes target the current main branch;
there are no supported stable release branches yet.

Please use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting][report] if enabled.
Otherwise, open an issue asking for a private reporting channel. Leave out
technical exploitation details, credentials, private URLs, and user data.

[report]: https://github.com/flemzord/t3fleet/security/advisories/new

See [the security model](../docs/security.md) for credential storage, transport,
snapshot, and deployment assumptions.
